gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-warang-c: Bent-tubing letters, bold and bouncy. Noto Sans Warang Citi follows in a plain sans whose words settle into solid blocks, so a long passage moves along without snagging.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-yi: Round, chunky, and sure of itself, College leads with curves as thick as its stems. Noto Sans Yi has a deep lowercase midsection and open rounds, though shrinking the heading would blunt its punch.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Every curve in College is as thick as its straight stems, and its lowercase counters gape wide and tall. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square stays crisp beneath it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-traditional-n: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like broad-nibbed pen strokes. College, bent from one length of tubing, shouts above it while the body keeps its bowls full and relaxed.
gen-dafont-college-gf-numans: Modern and crisp, Numans spreads its swollen lowercase wide, with an s whose ends hang far from the spine. College is the one for shouting; Numans is for quiet.
gen-dafont-college-gf-onest: Approachable is the word for Onest, with short ascenders above big bowls and a gentle line weight. A long passage in it would flow smoothly, never tiring.
gen-dafont-college-gf-orienta: Every diagonal in College is as stout as its uprights, giving it a blunt, authoritative punch. Orienta, though, lets its counters breathe, so it handles the quieter, running text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-oxygen: Chunky, tube-like College hits hard with a marker-nib line. And Oxygen sits beside it with open curves and a lowercase nearly matching its capitals, a softer voice.
gen-dafont-college-gf-parkinsans: College is all fat curves and tall counters, loud and sure. But Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, so its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp underneath.
gen-dafont-college-gf-pathway-extreme: College draws a single-width stroke in every glyph, tubing-thick and loud. Pathway Extreme then offers open rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, which keeps long reading easy.
